sections.Profile:
"Star Race" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1980. It features a space race theme with four flippers, no ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 80 series, it was designed by John Buras with artwork by David Moore. A total of 3,597 units were produced.
